::::

```{=html}
<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".category-btn");
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".g-col-1"); // tarjetas que tienen data-categories

    function decodeBase64(encoded) {
      try {
        return decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(encoded))).toLowerCase().trim();
      } catch (e) {
        return "";
      }
    }

    buttons.forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove("active"));
        button.classList.add("active");

        const selectedEncoded = button.getAttribute("data-categories");
        if (selectedEncoded === "all") {
          cards.forEach(card => card.style.display = "block");
          return;
        }

        cards.forEach(card => {
          const cardEncoded = card.getAttribute("data-categories");
          if (!cardEncoded) {
            card.style.display = "none";
            return;
          }

          if (cardEncoded === selectedEncoded) {
            card.style.display = "block";
          } else {
            card.style.display = "none";
          }
        });
      });
    });
  });
</script>
```
